changelog:
Initial release of the cold-email skill.

- Write effective B2B cold outreach emails and follow-up sequences.
- Covers subject lines, body copy, CTAs, personalization, and multi-touch follow-ups.
- Includes guidance for different audiences (C-suite, mid-level, technical).
- Provides frameworks, benchmarks, and anti-patterns to boost reply rates.
- For sales emails only (see "email-sequence" for nurture/warm campaigns).
